scripts.build:apk: npm run empacotar && eas update:configure --platform android --non-interactive && eas build -p android --profile preview
scripts.build:android: npm run empacotar && eas update:configure --platform android --non-interactive && eas build -p android --profile production
scripts.build:ios: npm run empacotar && eas build -p ios --profile production
scripts.atualizar: npm run empacotar && eas update --branch preview --message "Atualização do jogo" --non-interactive
